input.quote: 14.10 Complete Understanding. This Agreement including all Exhibits, and the Non Disclosure Agreement and the Statement of Work referenced in this Agreement and incorporated by reference herein, constitutes the final, complete and exclusive agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, and supersedes any prior or contemporaneous agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance provision anywhere: Section 14 (Miscellaneous) runs from assignment through complete understanding with no insurance covenant, the indemnity in Section 8 imposes none, and searches for "insurance", "coverage", "certificate" and "policy" return only the definitional reference to freight and insurance deductions in Section 1. Commerce One is a software licensor providing installation support, maintenance and training, so the playbook expects insurance. We have inserted the fallback position only (E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of USD 2,000,000) as the shortest complete clause, and renumbered the following subsection so the numbering remains coherent. Preferred CGL, workers' compensation and certificate-on-request terms are available if Commerce One prefers the fuller provision.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance clause (E&O USD 1M; cyber USD 2M) in Miscellaneous
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance clause, so we have added a short provision requiring Commerce One to carry errors and omissions coverage of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy coverage of USD 2,000,000. This is our fallback insurance position for a software and support vendor.

ops.text: 14.10 Insurance. Commerce One shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber liability and privacy insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.
